title: Student Survey Advisory Group Member
bio: Hi! My name is Caleb Masshardt, and I am a sophomore in Winthrop House studying Government with a secondary in History. Outside of class, I am involved with the Institute of Politics, Harvard Undergraduate Association, and Peer Advising Fellow (PAF) program. I also enjoy playing pickleball and making music (guitar and violin).
